svg.title: Harness object model — attributes derived from JSON Schema

g.text: Harness object model — attributes derived from JSON Schema
lifecycleStages [0..*] : list<plan | author | validate | review | test | publish | feedback | retire>
authority [1] : OMG | DCMI | W3C | IETF | ISO | HL7 | other
subject.kind [1] : process | decision | role | requirement | skill | graph | tool
pair_attestations [0..*] : {kind, prose, code, prose_hash, code_hash, by, reason}[]
The harness itself still holds stories as
XSD, not JSON Schema: the elements
listed are the operative terms pinned
